description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ListingCreate/GetDataByPSIds. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Loads current supplier data for the exact product-source variations used during manual multi-variation product creation. ownerAgent: publication. Domain: publication. Entity: product_source_variation_data. Operation: read_and_refresh. Scope: selected_channel. Use when: Use it when the manual product form needs price, stock, EAN and source images for a known set of exact ProductSourceIds, especially before displaying or publishing all supplier variations. Do not use it to discover products or variations without exact ProductSourceIds, or for existing store-listing collection or ranking. Input: [FromBody] rq: GetDataByPSIdsRequest. Main fields: ProductSourceIds: int[]. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Admin: false. Output: Returns ProductSources keyed by the requested ProductSourceId, with available images, price, stock and EAN. For a new listing, each variation is read from its exact supplier URL, including its images, price, stock and EAN when available. Missing supplier images remain empty. Explicit AliExpress children missing a supplier SKU require confirmed identity, price and stock; unavailable sizes from Matalan or Home Bargains report zero when confirmed. Search terms: listingcreate getdatabypsids. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.
